title: ADAS Engineer
summary: ADAS engineers work on driver-assistance features such as adaptive cruise control, emergency braking and lane keeping. They combine camera and radar data, tune and calibrate the features on test vehicles and check them against safety rules, inside a vehicle software or supplier engineering team.
dailyDuties: Tune ADAS feature parameters on test vehicles
Analyse drive logs of camera and radar data
Calibrate functions with measurement and calibration tools
Simulate and check functions in MATLAB and Simulink
Review network signals in CANoe after a test drive
Report issues and fixes to the algorithm team

skills.expectation: Work on driver-assistance features such as ACC, AEB and lane keeping
Combine camera, radar and ultrasonic data and tune tracking filters
Calibrate and tune ADAS functions on vehicles with INCA or CANape
Model, simulate and analyse functions in MATLAB and Simulink
Work with CAN and CAN-FD signals in the vehicle
Log and analyse vehicle network traffic with CANoe or CANalyzer
Script log analysis and test reports from vehicle drives
Follow ISO 26262 safety requirements for ADAS functions
Understand camera perception outputs such as object and lane detection
Read and change algorithm code in C++
Plan vehicle and track tests for ADAS features
Log and follow up issues found on test drives

certifications.why: ADAS functions are safety-critical, and ISO 26262 knowledge is often listed as a plus.
